blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu —The Lapu-Lapu City Council has asked the officials and representatives of the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP), Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC), and Mactan Electric Company (MECO) to attend their next session to shed light on the rotational brownouts that the city is experiencing. The City Council also changed the schedule of their session after they observed that brownouts were likely to happen in the afternoon. Instead of having their session in the afternoon, the city council moved their session to 10:00 a.m. on every Wednesday.
